[[The Soul Reaper]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Grim Peacekeeper]]s, [[White Mantle Ritualist]]s, and [[White Mantle Fanatic]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Dark damage]] 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +60 

==Skin==
This item has the same skin as the [[Darkwing Staff]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Soul Reaping]] [[staves]]:
**[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[Soul Reaping]] [[staves]]:
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Necromantic Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Soul Spire]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Grim Shadow Staff]], [[Staff of the Hierophant]] and the [[Soul Reaping]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Kerrsh's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]].
